test_collect_schema: test the LazyFrame.collect_schema() method returns the correct column names and dtypes
test_collect_schema_parametric: test collect_schema() matches the schema of a collected LazyFrame using parametric dataframes
test_collect_schema_with_row_index_dupli: test that collect_schema() raises DuplicateError when with_row_index() creates a duplicate column
test_collect_schema_unpivot_duplicate: test that collect_schema() raises DuplicateError when unpivot() creates a duplicate column
test_lazyframe_schema_consistency: test that LazyFrame.collect_schema() is consistent with LazyFrame.collect().schema
